preview: Use case: ui-mockup. Revise the attached AshenSpire HUD reference preserving its weathered dark metal circular frames, warm silver/brass edge highlights, sapphire diamond mana gems, dark backdrop and premium painted fantasy style. Show three matching controls across a wide landscape image, with respectively 3, 6, 12 sapphire mana diamonds equally spaced along the circular outer track starting at 12 o'clock. CRITICAL CHANGE: remove the tiny central green diamond badge. Make the entire INNER CIRCULAR FACE a deep luminous emerald-green stamina jewel/disc that fills the inner circle right up to its metal rim. The white number '3' is large and centered in the upper two-thirds of the green disc, and the white letters 'SP' are centered beneath, generous and readable. SP is a round filled inner face, not a small floating diamond. Keep mana sapphire diamonds separate on the outer metal track. Below label each '3 max MP', '6 max MP', '12 max MP'. All three full assembled examples same diameter. Under these, show a smaller tidy exploded component diagram labeled 'Frame', 'SP face', 'Mana gem', 'Spent gem', 'Live text', demonstrating separate hollow metal ring, blank round green jewel with no writing, bright blue diamond, dim blue diamond outline, and the typographic 3 / SP. No extra words, no invented ornament changes. Keep exact reference look; only enlarge and round the stamina inner fill.
